notes: Tuition: The pages state no tuition fees for this programme ("Tuition fees per semester None" / "Das Studium an der TU Ilmenau ist grundsätzlich gebührenfrei"), but only a semester contribution of approx. 320 EUR; no separate non-EU tuition is quoted, so tuition is left out. Application channel: the programme page's section for applicants with certificates from outside the EU/EEA links only uni-assist ("Benötigte Dokumente für Uniassist", "Bewerbung über uniassist"), so de-uni-assist was chosen over de-uni-assist-vpd (no VPD/preliminary review is mentioned). Documents: the pages do not give a per-document checklist for this programme; only "Zeugnisse" (certificates) are named for the non-EU/EEA application route. Intake: the application period 16.1. bis 30.09. is given for applicants with non-EU/non-EEA certificates for the winter semester; no year is stated, but a separate page lists winter semester 2026 periods, so the deadline was set to 2026-09-30; the start of studies (1 October) is not tied to a year and was left null.
